sensitiveScan.help: Reads a sample of the table's text columns in the background and looks for sensitive values inside the text, such as a social security number in a note. Only the share of values is kept, never the values. A hint changes nothing by itself: choose a grant, mask or fake for the column.
sensitiveScan.saveFirst: Save the table to scan its values.
sensitiveScan.running: Scanning a sample of the text columns…
sensitiveScan.succeeded: Last scan: {{rows}} sampled rows, {{columns}} text columns.
